children: Baker Hughes provided updated FY‑26 guidance that incorporates the July 16 Chart acquisition and outlines revised revenue, EBITDA and cash conversion targets.
Presented at Barclays CEO Energy‑Power Conference; management furnished presentation as Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8‑K.
Updated FY‑26 combined revenue guidance: $28.5B–$30.3B and adjusted EBITDA $4,875M–$5,475M (company midpoint $29.4B/$5,175M).
Chart contribution for FY‑26: revenue $1,850M–$2,250M and EBITDA $300M–$400M; Chart included from July 16, 2026 close.
FCF conversion targeted at 40%–45%; adjusted effective tax rate 22%–26%; corporate costs ~ $325M and D&A ~ $1,400M.
Integration plan: $35M synergies realized since closing, multi‑year cost and commercial synergies, and Business System roll‑out to expand margins.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
